allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

versioning.description: Versioning strategy for spec artifacts (e.g., semantic versioning, date-based).

pr_rules.description: CI checks that must pass on every pull request before merge.

items.description: A CI check command that runs as part of the PR pipeline.

spec_first_policy.description: Whether the spec-first policy is enforced, requiring spec changes before code changes.

commit_message_rules.description: Rules governing commit message format and content.

require_spec_ids.description: Whether commit messages must include spec artifact IDs.

pattern.description: Regex pattern that commit messages must match.

id_pattern_ref.description: Canonical reference for the ID pattern used in commit messages.

error_message.description: Human readable guidance. MUST list allowed types/values if a specific set is required.

review_policy.description: Policy governing code review requirements and evidence collection.

verdict_requirements.description: Conditions that must be met for a review verdict to be accepted.

items.description: A condition that must be met for a review verdict to be accepted.

required_metadata.description: Metadata fields required in every review submission.

evidence_source_by_phase.description: Mapping of deployment phases to their evidence sources.

dev.description: Evidence source for the development phase.

staging.description: Evidence source for the staging phase.

prod.description: Evidence source for the production phase.

reviewers.description: List of designated reviewers responsible for spec and code reviews.

trace.description: Traceability links connecting this governance spec to related artifacts.

items.description: A traceability reference for the governance spec.

links.description: External links to related governance resources or documentation.

items.description: A link to an external governance resource.

policy_ref.description: Canonical reference for the governance policy in the registry.

command_ref.description: Canonical reference for the governance CLI command.
